title: Gleipnir
summary: Gleipnir is a magical rope which cannot be broken through any means.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Thor used this rope to tether the wild Titan Fenris.

Dante Vale, Zhalia Moon, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert and Cherit found the rope wrapped around a statue in a chamber located within the Temple of Thor. Because of its magical nature, they could not untie it without the help of Lok's Springer. They used the rope to tether Fenris, which otherwise could not be defeated due to the magic of the temple, and sent him back to his Amulet. [Two Powers Become One]
